title: Keys Revoke — payload
description: Retire a key from further use. The record is retained so historic signatures stay attributable; this is not a delete.

keyId.description: Identifier of the key to retire.

reason.description: Optional human-readable rationale, recorded with the revocation.

Response.title: Keys Revoke — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a keys/revoke request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/keys/revoke/0.1#response.

status.description: The lifecycle state now in effect — `revoked` on success. Returned rather than assumed so a caller reading only the response can see the realized state.

updatedAt.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the revocation. The boundary between signatures made while the key was valid and requests refused afterwards.
